record.title: Endoscopic transfer of Arthur’s stable distributions via normalized vanishing cycles
record.statement:
Let $G$ be $\mathrm{GL}_n$, $\mathrm{SO}_{2n+1}$, or $\mathrm{Sp}_{2n}$, and let $\psi$ be a local Arthur parameter with corresponding Langlands parameter $\phi_\psi$. For every semisimple $s\in Z_{\widehat G}(\psi)$, the endoscopic transfer of Arthur’s stable distributions is calculated by normalized vanishing cycles:
\[
\eta_{\psi,s}=\eta^{\mathrm{NEvs}}_{\phi_\psi,s}.
\]

record.title: Volume maximization for convolution bodies
record.statement: Is there a value of $\delta\in(0,1)$ such that $|C_\delta K|_n\le |C_\delta B_K|_n$ for every symmetric convex body $K$? Here $C_\delta K=\{x\in\mathbb{R}^n:g_K(x)\ge\delta|K|_n\}$, $g_K(x)=|K\cap(K+x)|_n$, and $B_K$ is the Euclidean ball having the same volume as $K$.

record.title: Measure comparison for dilations with an intersection-body density
record.statement:
Let \bc be a log-concave measure on \c3n such that its density is given by $d\bc(x)=e^{-\(\x\_M)}\,dx$, where $M$ is an intersection body. Consider convex symmetric bodies $K,L\subset \c3n$ satisfying
$$\bc(tK\cap \u0006\^\)\le \bc(tL\cap \u0006\^\)\qquad\text{for all }\u0006\\in S^{n-1}\text{ and all }t>0.$$
Does it follow that $\bc(K)\le \bc(L)$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2024/58](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/14298808), page 35. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Affine quermassintegral inequality over real, complex, and quaternionic spaces
record.statement:
For every convex body $K\subseteq \mathbb{F}^n$ with non-empty interior, where $\mathbb{F}\in\{\mathbb{R},\mathbb{C},\mathbb{H}\}$, $p=\dim_{\mathbb{R}}\mathbb{F}\in\{1,2,4\}$, and $m\in\{1,\ldots,n-1\}$, 
$$|K|^{-m}\ge \frac{(\kappa_{mp})^n}{(\kappa_{np})^m}\int_{\operatorname{Gr}_m(n,\mathbb{F})}|P_EK|^{-n}\,dE,$$
with equality if and only if $K$ is a real, complex, or quaternionic ellipsoid.

record.statement: Let $G_q$ be the collection of groups $G_{E,P}(\fF_q)$ arising from elliptic curves $E:y^2=x^3+ax+b$ with $a,b\in\u000cF_q$ and points $P\in E(\u000cF_q)$, where $G_{E,P}$ is the unipotent group scheme associated with $(E,P)$. record.title: An $L^p\to L^q$ fractal local smoothing conjecture
record.statement:
For every $1<p\le q<\infty$ with $q>p'$, the conjecture is that
\[
\left(\sum_{t\in E_j}\left\|e^{it\sqrt{-\Delta}}P_jf\right\|_{L^q(\mathbb{R}^d)}^q\right)^{1/q}\le C\,2^{js}\|f\|_{L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)}
\]
holds for all $j\ge 1$ whenever
\[
s>\frac{d+1}{2}\left(\frac1p-\frac1q\right)+\frac1q\,\nu_E^\sharp\!\left(\frac{q(d-1)}{2}\left(1-\frac1p-\frac1q\right)\right).
\]

record.title: Finite-direction characterization of GBD
record.statement:
Let $u:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}^d$ be measurable. Assume that, for every $\xi\in W:=\{e_i:i=1,\ldots,d\}\cup\{e_i+e_j:1\le i<j\le d\}$, 
\[
\int_{\xi^\perp}\left(|D u_z^\xi|(\Omega_z^\xi\setminus J u_z^\xi)+\sum_{s\in J u_z^\xi}|u_z^\xi(s+0)-u_z^\xi(s-0)|\wedge 1\right)\,d\mathcal{H}^{d-1}(z)<+\infty.
\]
Then $u\in\mathrm{GBD}(\Omega)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2025/33](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/14299519), page 19. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

\]

record.title: The Huang–Yang low-density expansion for the balanced spin-\[?]1/2 Fermi gas
record.statement:

record.title: Decategorified conjecture for unitary Yang–Baxter operators
record.statement: Let $(R,V)$ be a unitary solution to the Yang–Baxter equation. Then, for all $n$, the image $\rho_R(B_n)$ is a virtually abelian group; equivalently, $\rho_R(B_n)$ has a normal abelian subgroup of finite index.
